http.instructions: Send JSON {tool, arguments}. HTTP retry identity belongs in the Idempotency-Key header, never arguments.idempotency_key; MCP uses idempotency_key inside its tool arguments.

cooldown_s.description: After a run starts, further starts within this many seconds are skipped and counted in skipped_runs

only_if.description: The whole flow runs only if this holds, checked before the first step (it may read the trigger, not a step); a start that doesn't is skipped and counted in skipped_runs. Same tests as a step's only_if

max_runs_per_day.description: After this many runs since local midnight, further starts are skipped

max_paid_per_day.description: With ask_model steps: paid questions per day (default 50)

latitude.description: Required for geofence; optional for sun (otherwise the phone saves a rough position once, scope location)

rule.description: For watch with on: rule: the tally rule id

type.description: called: only a watch rule, a schedule or workflow.run starts it

for_s.description: For power: unplugged fires once the phone has been off charge this long (600 = a power cut); restored fires when charging comes back after at least this long off; plugged after this long charging (default 0)

application_id.description: Legacy alias for applet_id; if both are supplied they must agree

offset_min.description: For sun: minutes before (negative) or after sunrise or sunset (default 0)

with.description: For called: the values callers may hand over, {name: text|number|boolean} (0-8); steps read them as {"$trigger":"with.<name>"}

event_type.description: Only dispatch this normalized event type; omitted accepts all

watch.description: Required for watch: the id of one of your watches

cooldown_seconds.description: Per device and normalized type (default 30); if given, also the flow's cooldown_s (its old name)

from.description: For mode: only a change from this mode

to.description: For mode: start when the phone's mode changes to this (home, away, night, vacation or one the owner added); omitted: any change

on.description: For watch: match (default) or rule. For power: unplugged, plugged or restored. For battery: low, critical, okay, full, saver_on, saver_off, hot, cooled. For sun: sunrise or sunset

longitude.description: Required for geofence; optional for sun

data.description: For send: up to 32 keys, each a literal or a {"$step"} / {"$trigger"} reference (16 KiB)

questions.description: Required for ask_model: {id: {type: choice|noul|…, instructions, criteria?}}, as in watches

title.description: Required for notice and ask_owner. Text, a {"$step":"id.path"} or {"$trigger":"path"} reference, or a list of texts and references

mode.description: Required for set_mode: one of the phone's modes (GET /v2/mode lists them)

limit.description: For lookup: how many of the newest rows to return (default 1); count counts them all

on_error.description: stop (default: end the run), skip (carry on) or retry

where.description: For lookup: only rows whose column is this value, {"column":"taken","is":false}

id.description: Name this step to use its result later: {"$step":"<id>.<field>"}

text.description: Required for speak, alert and event, and for send to a chat service; optional for notice, ask_owner and send. Text, a {"$step":"id.path"} or {"$trigger":"path"} reference, or a list of texts and references

camera.description: For photo: rear (default), front or a local camera id lan:…

table.description: For record, update and lookup: a table of the applet

hours.description: For lookup: only rows from the last N hours (instead of since)

only_if.description: Run only if (docs/applet-reach.md D1). One test: {"step":"<id>.<path>" or "trigger":"<path>", plus one of is, is_not, in, at_least, below, exists}; {"time":{"between":["22:00","07:00"],"days":["mon",…]}}; {"sun":{"after" or "before":"sunrise" or "sunset","offset_min":0}}; {"phone":"charging","is":true} (battery at_least/below, network is wifi/mobile/none); {"zone":{latitude,longitude,radius_m},"is":true}; {"mode":true,"is":"away"}; {"count":{"table","since":"today"|"this_week"|"all" or "hours":N,"where":{column,is}},"below":3}; {"sum":{…,"column"},"at_least":50}. Or {"all":[2-8 tests]} / {"any":[…]}, one level

destinations.description: Required for alert: 1-3 owner-approved destination ids

photo.description: For ask_model: {"$step":"<photo step id>.photo"}; for send: {"$step":"<photo step id>"} or a kept photo

wait_s.description: For ask_owner: how long to wait for an answer (default 300)

wait_reply.description: For send: wait up to 15 s and return status and reply (JSON) or reply_text

to.description: Required for send: a connection id from GET /v1/connections (never a URL)

since.description: For lookup: today, this_week or all (default)
